C-PLAN-QUALITY.Summary: Phase 10 stage 1 draft (A70). Deliver D10 plan-quality signal: record review scope so task- and wave-scoped outcomes cannot be pooled; store resolution classification (implementation vs plan defect) at the moment of resolution (standing rule 13); store the all-tasks-passed precondition for the decomposition inference; publish the proxy caveat beside the number; surface the report on doctor (peer of Calibration). Do not re-implement §10.4 doctor checks that already fire on lint, health, or gates (D16 / findings 173–174).
C-PLAN-QUALITY.Problem:
D10 is the only signal that measures the plan rather than the agent. §10 was written before Phases 5–9 and C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS landed. At 0a4b1b3 (A70):
1. Finding 172. src/grace-doctor.test.ts exists (200 lines). §10.3 CREATE is wrong; EDIT.
2. Findings 173, 177. Three of four §10.4 doctor checks already exist: IC-* owner/version → projection.graph.invalid-interface-contract (error); ST-* evidence → health.ui-state-unverified / health.ui-states-undeclared; unresolved clarifications → gate.approve / gate.apply clarification-unresolved. Rebuilding them in doctor on a lint-clean project is a vacuous green (D16), the class C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS just removed. Rule-12 subjects on this repo: 0 IC-*, 0 UI_COMPONENT ST-* states, 0 open blocking clarifications.
3. Finding 174. AC-* unmapped Satisfies half exists as change.acceptance-criterion-unmapped (warning). The "no V-M-* path" half has no artifact edge: AC is change-scoped, V-M is module-scoped. Inventing the join is a sixteenth design decision (§12.5). Defer under rule 7 with recorded absence.
4. Finding 175. D10 claims classification is a join because "amendments are ledger events." At HEAD there is no amendment event kind. Supersede is status + Replacement. Roadmap plan.md amendments are not ledger events. Classification must be stored (rule 13).
5. Finding 176. ReviewVerdictRecord is outcome | reason? | note? with no scope. Ten archive Verdicts, all pass, none scoped; wave= count on archive ledgers is 0. Pooling cannot be prevented by data that was never written.
6. A2 doctor baseline (Governed files: 0, no calibration) is stale. A70.2 re-captures Governed files: 58 and calibration present. §10.5.4 Phase-1 silence target is gone.
What is real: wave optional on Epoch-N and opened; fold-time CalibrationAdjudication storage at grace-cursor.ts:2075 (rule 13 model); M-REVIEW owns src/review/*; doctor is read-only and already hosts Calibration as a consumer section.

Goals.Goal: Review outcomes carry scope (task | wave | bundle) so task-scoped and wave-scoped failures are distinguishable and cannot be pooled into one unlabeled rate (D10).
Resolution classification (implementation defect | plan defect) is stored when the resolution is recorded, not reconstructed as the sole report-time truth (rule 13 / A65.2).
Wave-level review failure with every constituent task having passed its own verification is classifiable as decomposition failure only when the precondition is stored beside the outcome (D10).
The proxy caveat appears adjacent to the classification counts in text and JSON.
At N=0 (no scoped verdicts / no classifications) the report prints counts and an honest empty sentence — no flattering rate table (rule 11; Phase 9 pattern).
Doctor gains a plan-quality consumer section (peer of Calibration), read-only.
§10.4 checks already enforced elsewhere are not re-shipped as doctor-only copies (D16). AC↔V-M half is deferred under rule 7 with recorded reasoning (finding 174).
src/review/outcomes.ts is a governed file with MODULE_CONTRACT LINKS: M-REVIEW; plans that write it name M-REVIEW under GraphAnchors (ownership is LINKS, not directory prefix).

Constraints.Constraint: Spec only until planned and approved. This draft schedules work; it does not authorize production code (same shape as C-CALIBRATION / C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS stage 1).
Standing rule 12: every new check or rate is run over this repository as it is; flag counts are recorded. A check with zero subjects is unmeasured, not clean.
Standing rule 11: every sentence the plan-quality report emits must read true aloud given the inputs the run actually had — especially at N=0 and for unscoped historical verdicts.
Standing rule 13: scope, classification, and constituentTasksPassed are written when they are true (or known false); report-time reconstruction is not the primary source of truth.

Standing rule 7 / A12.4: AC↔V-M half and doctor re-copies of IC/ST/clarification are amended as deferred or rejected with reasoning, never silently retargeted under the same heading while claiming the original check shipped.
D5: absence of scope is absence with a reason, never a default of task or wave.
D14: plan-quality is a doctor/report consumer of ledger review outcomes, not a fourth check surface that invents review.* or gate.* codes from lint.
Invariant 5: additive only. Existing Verdicts without scope remain valid; projects without classifications lint and doctor clean aside from honest absence reporting.
Invariant 8 / F1: doctor and the report stay read-only. Writers are gate verdict / ledger append paths already used for Verdicts.
No new runtime dependencies. Skill mirrors stay byte-identical if skill text changes. Surgical diffs. No abstraction for a single caller.

GraphAnchors / ObservedWriteScope: any new src/review/outcomes.ts path is linked via MODULE_CONTRACT LINKS: M-REVIEW and listed in OWS with GraphAnchors including M-REVIEW, or change.graph-anchors-miss-write-scope is an error.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Re-implementing IC owner/version, ST evidence, or clarification gates inside doctor as duplicate checkers (findings 173, 177).
Building an AC-* → V-M-* edge that does not exist in the artifact model (finding 174). Deferred under rule 7 until a ratified model exists.
Classifying roadmap plan.md §14 amendments as plan defects from change ledgers (finding 175 FN class). Out of band.
Consuming claimedConfidence or plan-quality rates in any gate (D6 / D10 are write and report, not gate inputs).
Defaulting historical unscoped Verdicts to task or wave (D5).
Editing archived run-ledgers to backfill scope or classification (archives are history).
Necessarily renaming analysisIssues in the same change (A7.4); may be co-located if the doctor JSON shape is already open, otherwise a separate named home.

Proposals.P1-Doctor-Consumer: Doctor gains plan-quality report section, not re-lint of §10.4 checks 2–4. Cost: outcomes module + doctor format/JSON + tests.
Proposals.P2-Scope-On-Verdict: Optional scope attribute on Verdict (task|wave|bundle); unscoped → scope-not-recorded absence. Cost: ledger type + CLI + tests.
Proposals.P3-Store-Classification: Store resolution classification at resolution time; helper may propose from supersede. Cost: write path + stored fields + both-direction tests.
Proposals.P4-Supersede-Mechanism: Plan defect evidence: status=superseded + Replacement; escalation/replan optional link; code-only is explicit residual. Cost: docs of FN + implement supersede path.
Proposals.P5-Precondition-Stored: constituentTasksPassed stored on wave-scoped fail at write. Cost: membership + terminal scan + stored attribute.
Proposals.P6-Caveat-Adjacent: Fixed proxy caveat sentence in text and JSON next to counts. Cost: shared constant + test.
Proposals.P7-N0-Honest: N=0: counts + empty sentence + unscoped count; no rate table. Cost: formatter branches.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SCOPE-ON-VERDICT: D10 / step 10.5.1. New Verdicts may carry scope=task|wave|bundle (enum fixed at stage-2 plan time). Discriminating negatives: (a) a query or report API that pools task-scoped and wave-scoped outcomes into one unlabeled rate is impossible or is a tested error; (b) unscoped historical Verdicts read as absence reason scope-not-recorded, never as a default scope; (c) omitting scope remains valid on write (additive); (d) an invalid scope token is rejected at write.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-CLASSIFICATION-STORED: D10 / step 10.5.2 / rule 13. Resolution classification implementation|plan is stored when the resolution is recorded (or explicitly asserted), and the report reads the stored value. Discriminating negatives: (a) report-time-only recompute without a stored field is not the primary path; (b) a change resolved by supersede (status=superseded + Replacement) can be classified plan when so recorded; (c) a code-only resolution classifies implementation when so recorded; (d) both directions asserted against real ledger XML, not mocks of the join alone.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-AMENDMENT-PREMISE-AMENDED: Finding 175 / rule 7. Docs and skill text do not claim "amendments are already ledger events" as the sole ground for classification. Discriminating negatives: (a) no user-facing sentence asserts that every plan defect leaves an amendment event kind; (b) supersede + Replacement and explicit resolution records are named as the joinable artifacts; (c) roadmap plan.md amendments are named as out of band.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-DECOMPOSITION-PRECONDITION: D10 / step 10.5.3. A wave-scoped fail is classified decomposition only when stored constituentTasksPassed is true. Discriminating negatives: (a) wave fail where one constituent task failed verification is not decomposition; (b) missing precondition is absence with a reason, not an inferred true; (c) report does not re-derive the precondition from present-state terminals as primary truth.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-PROXY-CAVEAT-ADJACENT: D10 / step 10.5.5. The proxy caveat sentence is adjacent to the classification counts in text and present as a JSON field on the same report object. Discriminating negatives: (a) caveat only in a distant footnote or skill page is insufficient; (b) JSON without the field when counts are present fails the test; (c) wording matches the read-aloud constant (rule 11).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-REPORT-N0: Step 10.5 / A70.8. Over this repository (and any tree with no scoped verdicts or classifications), the report prints counts and an honest empty sentence. Discriminating negatives: (a) no rate table that implies plan-quality calibration; (b) no "0% plan defects" or "plan quality: OK"; (c) unscoped verdicts are counted as scope-not-recorded, not assigned a default scope; (d) read-aloud of the N=0 sentence is true at 0a4b1b3.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-DOCTOR-CONSUMER: Doctor (read-only) surfaces the plan-quality report as a section peer to Calibration. Discriminating negatives: (a) doctor does not write the ledger; (b) doctor does not emit a green requirements-quality OK for IC/ST/clarification checks it did not run; (c) JSON and text both carry the report or an explicit absence.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-NO-VACUOUS-DOCTOR-RECHECKS: Findings 173–174 / D16 / rule 7. Stage 2 does not ship doctor-only duplicates of IC owner/version, ST evidence, or clarification gates under the §10.4 headings. Discriminating negatives: (a) no new issue code that is green on every tree solely because subjects are absent; (b) AC↔V-M is documented deferred, not implemented as a vacuous check; (c) rule-12 counts from A70.5 remain the recorded baseline for those deferred items.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-OUTCOMES-MODULE: src/review/outcomes.ts and outcomes.test.ts exist under M-REVIEW (MODULE_CONTRACT LINKS: M-REVIEW; export parity). Discriminating negatives: (a) GraphAnchors omit M-REVIEW while OWS lists outcomes.ts → change.graph-anchors-miss-write-scope error; (b) MAP_MODE EXPORTS fails if the map lies; (c) package.json#files already covers src/review (C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS) so no pack regression for the new file.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-DOCTOR-TEST-EDIT: Finding 172. src/grace-doctor.test.ts is EDIT not CREATE; plan-quality cases land there and/or co-located outcomes tests. Discriminating negative: stage 2 does not delete the existing doctor suite to replace it with a thinner one (scope audit / A3.1).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-VALIDATE-CI: bun run validate:ci green after stage 2 implementation. Discriminating negative: typecheck, unit/integration, validate:cli, validate:marketplace, validate:packed all pass; root ngrace lint 0 errors; rule-12 counts reported for every new check that ships.

ReadAloud.N0Sentence: Plan-quality report: 0 review verdicts with recorded scope, 0 resolution classifications, 0 decomposition candidates. No plan-quality rate is computed. N verdicts lack scope (scope-not-recorded) and are excluded from rates. Proxy caveat: a code-only fix can paper over a plan defect and is scored as implementation. This classification is a proxy, not a ground truth.
ReadAloud.N0TruthConditions: True when the project has no Verdict with a recorded scope attribute and no stored resolution classification. At 0a4b1b3, N=10 unscoped pass verdicts, zero wave= on archive ledgers, zero fail review verdicts, zero superseded bundles — so the only honest live output is counts plus absence, never a rate. A flatter sentence like "plan quality: OK" or "0% plan defects" would be false in the flattering direction (rule 11 / A46.3).
